title: feat: Bee Census wishlist for features and models
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Turns the single "magic wand" answer into an open wishlist: list any features or models you'd like on Pollinations, plus fixes
- Free text, so answers aren't limited to options we thought of

Follow-up to #15735.

gist.headline: The hive takes requests
gist.blurb: Bee Census has room for the whole wishlist now. Add the features, models, and fixes you want, even if nobody thought to put them on a list.
gist.summary: Bee Census replaces its single “magic wand” answer with an open-text wishlist for multiple Pollinations features, models, and fixes.
gist.impact: People filling out Bee Census can suggest as many ideas as they like without being limited to predefined options.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Bee Census as a cozy garden suggestion box: Polli adds handwritten feature, model, and fix ideas to a growing wishlist, with each note sprouting a small flower. The open notebook represents free-text answers rather than a fixed set of choices.
